notes: Added remaining stories to complete schema validation, frontend rendering, and test coverage for explainability layer.

stories.title: Explainability Schema Definition and Validation Models
stories.description: Define a standardized explainability schema (source, meaning, limitations, confidence) and implement Pydantic models to validate all explainability payloads across provider and clinical trial signals.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Metadata
stories.description: Update chat UI message rendering to display explainability fields (source links, meaning text, limitations disclaimers) in a structured and readable format within MessageBubble.

stories.title: Explainability Unit Tests for Mapping Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating that provider and clinical trial signals are correctly transformed into explainability schema, including edge cases (missing data, partial signals, conflicting sources).

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Explainability in Responses
stories.description: Implement integration tests ensuring that explainability metadata flows from domain services through facade, API, and into final chat responses consumed by the frontend.
